Notes.Name: First Weekday of Month
Notes.Snippet:
# Get first day of Month
$FirstWeekDay = Get-Date -day 1
# if day is Sat or Sun add days until it is not
while(0,6 -contains $FirstWeekDay.DayOfWeek.value__){
    $FirstWeekDay = $FirstWeekDay.AddDays(1)
}
$FirstWeekDay
Notes.Details: Returns the first weekday of the month for any given date.

Notes.Name: Last Weekday of Month
Notes.Snippet:
# Get last day of Month
$LastWeekDay = (Get-Date -day 1).AddMonths(1).AddMilliseconds(-1)
# if day is Sat or Sun subtract days until it is not
while(0,6 -contains $LastWeekDay.DayOfWeek.value__){
    $LastWeekDay = $LastWeekDay.AddDays(-1)
}
$LastWeekDay
Notes.Details: Returns the last weekday of the month for any given date.

Notes.Name: Convert Between Time Zones
Notes.Snippet:
param(
    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [datetime] $Date,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $FromTimeZoneId,

    [Parameter(Mandatory)]
    [string] $ToTimeZoneId
)

$fromTz = [TimeZoneInfo]::FindSystemTimeZoneById($FromTimeZoneId)
$toTz   = [TimeZoneInfo]::FindSystemTimeZoneById($ToTimeZoneId)

# Treat the input date as a "wall clock" time in the FROM time zone (not local/UTC).
# This avoids DateTime.Kind ambiguity and handles DST via GetUtcOffset($Date).
$unspecified = [DateTime]::SpecifyKind($Date, [DateTimeKind]::Unspecified)
$fromOffset  = $fromTz.GetUtcOffset($unspecified)

$fromDto = [DateTimeOffset]::new($unspecified, $fromOffset)

# Convert to target zone
[TimeZoneInfo]::ConvertTime($fromDto, $toTz)
Notes.Details: Convert from one Time Zone to another.
